capabilities: analyze selected IP addresses, networks, or hostnames with IVRE
insert IVRE data into notes via a command or hotkey
use IVRE ipdata and view data (via ivre db2view)
extras: The README's Usage section references screenshots that are not included; it only covers ipdata and view, so scan results must be converted with ivre db2view first.
intentEvidence: It combines the data from IVRE with the organization of Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull network data from IVRE for security work like pentests or threat intelligence.

relations.evidence: It grabs data from IVRE and brings it into Obsidian notes.

summary: IVRE integration that analyzes selected IP addresses, networks, or hostnames and brings network data from IVRE into notes.
